No other checkout, prior agent output, network or cloud service was used.

The repository's `validatePlanHistory` passed for both plans. The calculated digest of 36 changed files was `a8c3701eedc2242fa7331ac0218a6a094a5a528399580965008ee5de3883b9d9`, matching the export. `npm ci --offline --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund` succeeded (119 packages). npm warned that Node v25.9.0 and npm 11.12.1 do not satisfy the project's Node >=24 <25 requirement. `npm run evaluate -- --change phase-2-closure --base origin/main` passed all nine planned commands; `npm run evaluate -- --change care-guidance-clarification --base origin/main` passed all five. `npm run ci:gate -- origin/main` exited 1 because `evals/changes/phase-2-closure/exit-result.json` is missing. The gate checks scope and plan history and then validates each plan's run and handoff before its exit result; separate validation above covered both runs and handoffs. No exit record was fabricated. Evaluation generated only local derived run/trace files; the gate generated local reports. No source edits, merge, deployment, or external calls were performed.

The handoff identifies the CPU pilot and final independent review as pending. This continuation did not perform that experiment or assess full protocol success, verify hosted Node 24 CI, or independently review the substantive findings. Local passing commands do not establish those outcomes.
